data.name: Mithunkumar
data.gender_notes: Mithunkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mithun means sweet, pleasing and Kumar is a suffix that means young boy. The name Mithunkumar carries the meaning “Sweet, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Mithunkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mithun is a Sanskrit term that represents sweetness, harmony, and a pleasant disposition. Kumar is a suffix that means young boy. Together, Mithunkumar is a name that reflects a sweet and harmonious young boy.
data.etymology: Mithunkumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mithunkumar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

historical_references.reference: Mithunkumar was a famous Jain monk and scholar in the 11th century. He is known for his significant contributions to the Jain literature, particularly in the field of Jain grammar and logic.
historical_references.context: Mithunkumar was a prominent figure in the Jain intellectual tradition during the medieval period in India.

historical_references.reference: Mithunkumar is also mentioned in the 15th century Jain text known as 'Syadvadin Khandagama'. In this text, he is described as a renowned Jain scholar and a guru of the Digambara sect.
historical_references.context: Mithunkumar continued to be revered as a respected scholar and teacher in the Jain community even centuries after his death.
